name: getShortListingDetails
description: In this tool, generate a sorted list of candidates. Candidates with a "ProStatus" value of 2 are marked as "Under Consideration or On Hold," while those with a "ProStatus" value of 0 are marked as "Pending." if there is no given user query single statement return dont show the available date.
